title: Corporate-issuance hedging pressure in Treasuries: weekly (Mon/Tue issuance) and monthly (early-month issuance) patterns

families.DW: long ZF/ZN/ZB (0.10 / vol / 3 each) on Wednesday-Friday (pressure reverses after Mon/Tue issuance), flat Mon/Tue
families.IS: short ZF/ZN/ZB on the first 3 trading days of each month (heavy issuance and rate-lock selling), flat otherwise

selection: single settings; enters only if 2010-06..2022-12 Sharpe > 0.3
judgement: EQR book + entrants; ONE evaluation 2023-26 vs 1.231
